title: tc-context-window
description: What fills a model's context window, as a field of cells per part, with removal and compaction.

heading.description: The heading, and the group's name

parts.description: What fills the window, in order – each part takes the next run of cells

limit.description: Size of the context window in tokens

model.description: Small tag in the head, e.g. the model name

actionLabel.description: Label of a button on the tray (Clean: in the card's last row), e.g. "New chat" – it fires tc-action

warnAt.description: Share of the limit from which the card warns (0–1)

cells.description: Number of cells and how many sit in one row

columns.description: How many cells sit in one row (two thirds of it, at least 8, in a narrow container)

tokens.description: Tokens of this part – ignored when `items` are given (then it is their sum)

items.description: Single things inside this part that can be removed, e.g. attached files

locked.description: Nothing can be removed or compacted here, e.g. the system prompt

compact.description: Shows a Compact button. A number is the share that stays after compacting (default 0.3)

color.description: Any CSS color – defaults to a fixed palette in the order of the parts
